scope: All40 selected Scalar/Multi B checkpoints; alternate same-model deployment. All120 selected checkpoints provide inference-cost controls. No new optimization or checkpoint selection.
construction: For each forced bank, evaluate logit on x_j=-1+2j/5, j=0..4, tensor grid. B[j,:]=basis(x_j), D=diag(1/5,2/5,2/5,2/5,2/5), C=D@B.T@Z@B@D. The bias is included in Z. Never route grid points or fit regression.
independent_reference: Laurent-polynomial propagation of half-angle gate amplitudes and Pauli expectation conjugate products; convert to same real tensor basis independently of the construction grid.
parity: Every bank; all validation rows; all test rows only after root release; fixed off-grid and router-boundary fixtures. Record maxima, every class difference and canonical probabilities; allow class differences only if both probabilities are within the declared band around0.5. Never replace canonical scoring.

benchmark.inputs: Lowest1024 numeric validation IDs per population, raw float64 coordinates; labels excluded.
benchmark.batch1: First128 ordered validation fixture rows, one call per row in each trial.
benchmark.batch32: All1024 rows partitioned into32 contiguous batches.
benchmark.batch1024: One1024-row batch repeated32 times per trial.
benchmark.order: Deterministic rotation of methods by seed/population/trial; reverse every odd trial; circuit/compiled order alternates within circuit method. Same input work per representation.
benchmark.clock: perf_counter_ns; collect complete trial durations and outputs/checksums; medians and interquartile ranges per checkpoint then summaries across five seeds. No quantum-device time inference.
benchmark.isolation: No live training, audits, compilation or other benchmark workers; one process and one BLAS thread. Background OS activity remains a limitation.
benchmark.scope: Hot in-memory raw-input inference. Do not include model loading in prediction latency; measure load and compilation separately and report artifacts bytes. The15 timing trials are technical repeats, not additional training seeds.

gate: Production and independent implementations plus preflight tests frozen before official inference run. Run once after root test release and all training is quiescent. Preserve every failure.
coefficient_diagnostic: Save per-bank coefficient-L1 discrepancy versus independent Laurent reference. Since every feature is bounded by1, this bounds the difference between the two coefficient polynomials for all real inputs; one quarter bounds sigmoid differences, excluding floating-point evaluation error. Finite fixture tests alone do not establish every-input numerical equality.

fixed_parity_fixtures.offgrid: 128 points from NumPy PCG64 SeedSequence([690621]), uniform[-1,1]^2; identical coordinates for every model/population.
fixed_parity_fixtures.router_boundary: For each pair of frozen training centroids, intersect its equal-distance line with the input box and all nearest-centroid halfspaces. For each positive-length Voronoi edge, use its midpoint and offsets -1e-10,0,+1e-10 along the normalized centroid-pair difference. Save coordinates, centroid pair, offsets and actual routes. No labels or held-out fitting.
fixed_parity_fixtures.forced_bank: In addition, all128 off-grid points are evaluated under each of the five forced banks; no routing for these per-bank parity checks.
